sbol:ComponentDefinition.dcterms:title: riboJ
sbol:ComponentDefinition.dcterms:description: Ribozyme-based insulator. Insulation in E.coli, P. putida and B.subtilis

sbol:ComponentDefinition.dcterms:title: IOT
sbol:ComponentDefinition.dcterms:description: Double Terminator. Induction Operon Terminator region. Termination in P. putida

sbol:ComponentDefinition.dcterms:title: Pars
sbol:ComponentDefinition.dcterms:description: Inducible promote. Activated by arsenic acid in Escherichia coli and P. putida. ArsR_protein binds to repress Pars promoter transcription in the absence of arsenic.
